_comment: Does giving the profile head a LEARNABLE target make the COUNTS head better? Both arms take the same ATAC input, the same DNase-derived elements, the same H3K27ac counts target and the same count_loss_weight; 1.28 is 1.11 plus two flags. Baseline is the status-quo arm whose profile head trains on H3K27ac, whose 1 bp inter-replicate ceiling is 0.21 and whose profile_pearson sits at 0.063-0.064 whatever it is fed (F-013). READ ONLY THE COUNTS COLUMNS: profile_pearson and profile_jsd here score both arms' profile heads against H3K27ac, so for the multi-task arm they measure how well a DNase-trained head happens to predict H3K27ac shape, which is not what it was trained for. CARRY THIS CAVEAT: early stopping watches the total validation loss, which for the multi-task arm includes the reweighted DNase profile term, so the arms trained for different lengths (53-99 epochs against 32-55). A positive result needs a 100-epoch baseline to separate the auxiliary task from the extra training.
